name: Etyek (Hungary)
description: Three vertical stripes of black, white and red in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Etyek: a black and red shield with ears of grain, a bunch of grapes and a wine press, above a red scroll inscribed ETYEK Edeck.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
